steps.what: opener, credibility, asks for a call, progress update

variants.body:
Hi {FIRST_NAME},

Just checking you saw the note above - would still love your take.

Quick update since I messaged: we've built a product that runs automated due diligence for PE. It maps how much of a target or portco can be AI-automated, flags where unnecessary software spend is happening, and surfaces where team structure can be optimised to drive more output - all in a detailed report within 2-4 weeks.

We're already on $500k with contracts that can expand toward $2m a year (I'm just a couple of months of trading). 

Would you be free for a call next week or the week after?

Best,
Jay
